content:
sanjay: Heads-up: noticed a persistent 8-12% tail-latency regression on our 8xA100 TP fwd path after the runtime merge last night. Repro on nightly build. Profiling points to a longer QKV all-gather hot path inside fused-attn when seq_len=2048, batch=4. cc @kira @alex

kira: Ugh. do you have the flamegraph / nvprof snippets?

sanjay: Quick paste from the trace capture and nvprof:
```
flamegraph summary: fused_attn_kernel 40% -> nccl_allgather 22% -> cudaMemcpy 10% -> kernel_launch_overhead 6%
nvprof sample: allgather latency ~1.8ms per step (prev ~0.3ms)
NCCL ops show many small fragments instead of one big payload
```

kira: That smells like the selector fell back to a slow scatter/generic path when combined QKV size crossed a shard-alignment boundary. Recent change to qkv packing might have shifted chunk sizes.

alex: I hit a similar pattern on 16k-context runs. Quick repro command: `./tools/run_bench.py --tp=8 --model=redwood-xxl --seq=2048 --batch=4 --profile=nvtx`
You can also force the selector to try the fast path: `export RW_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=flashfuse_fast_qkv` and rerun.

maria: Smaller seqs look fine, so this is likely an alignment/fragmentation issue in the KV cache -> all-gather handshake. Sanjay can you share the nvtx timeline link?

sanjay: Trace uploaded: <https://redwood/internal/trace/1808123456> . NCCL trace shows payloads split into ~512B fragments * N which increases op count and latency. Also seeing occasional host syncs between streams.

benchbot: perf-bench run summary: baseline p99=23.0ms -> current p99=25.2ms (+9.6%). GPU util in windows dropped by ~6% during the allgather stage.

kira: I ran a local patch that pads per-shard KV chunks to 64B alignment (branch kira/align-kv-chunks). Early run: p99 improved ~0.8ms on this config. Looks like fewer NCCL fragments.

sanjay: Patch results: with padding p99 -> 24.1ms. Nice improvement but still ~4.7% above baseline. I still see extra host syncs (cudaStreamSynchronize calls) in the timeline.

alex: Could be kernel launch ordering. Two knobs to try: (1) mark NCCL streams high-priority (`cudaStreamCreateWithPriority`) so comm can preempt and overlap, (2) prefer async device->device path (avoid host staging). Also enable continuous-batching to make each allgather bigger.

maria: Ops note: padding increases peak mem ~0.5GB/GPU on this model. If we patch, we should gate it behind a runtime flag `runtime.tp.comm_overlap=aggressive` (off by default).

ops: Feature-gate is fine, but please add memory regression numbers and a toggle in the dedicated capacity config UI.

kira: I'll open a PR with: padding patch, kernel-selector hardening to avoid fallback to `generic_qkv` over threshold, nvtx annotations around KV allgather, and perf runs vs xd-stage. Will include runs with and without `RW_KERNEL_OVERRIDE`.

sanjay: Also add NCCL op-count logging per step and a small regression test that runs the 2048/4 shape on CI nightlies so we detect future regressions early. :eyes:

maria: :thumbsup:

alex: Quick TODOs: 1) kira PR, 2) ops add flag + UI toggle, 3) add CI perf test, 4) prioritize kernel-selector unit test. If we can recover ~75% of the delta this week we can roll a canary.

sanjay: Thanks — I'll own the canary run and collect detailed nvprof traces once PR lands.
